name: lumpinee-stadium
description: Find upcoming Muay Thai fight nights at Lumpinee Boxing Stadium, Bangkok, see seating zones and the refund policy, and get the booking link.

interface.longDescription:
Find Muay Thai fight nights at Lumpinee Boxing Stadium in Bangkok.

What it does:
- Search upcoming events by date range or event name, in English or Thai.
- Show event details: date and time (Bangkok time), venue and map link, seating zones, refund policy, and a link to book on lumpinee.ticket-official.com.

Who it is for: fans and visitors who want to know what is on at Lumpinee and how to get tickets.

Limits:
- Read-only. It does not create, change or cancel anything.
- No sign-in. It never accesses your account, orders or payment details.
- Tickets are chosen and paid for on lumpinee.ticket-official.com, not in ChatGPT.
- It only covers events at Lumpinee Boxing Stadium.
capabilities: Show event details and booking link
defaultPrompt: What Muay Thai fights are on at Lumpinee this weekend?
Lumpinee, show me fights in December
Tell me about ONE Friday Fights next week — what seats are there?

positive.prompt: What Muay Thai fights are on at Lumpinee this weekend?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_events for this weekend's dates and shows the event list card. Each event has its date, status (on sale or sold out), starting price and a Buy button that opens lumpinee.ticket-official.com.

positive.description: Find events in a given month
positive.prompt: Lumpinee, show me fights in December
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_events with a December date range and shows every Lumpinee event that month in the list card.

positive.prompt: Tell me about ONE Friday Fights next week — what seats are there?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds next week's ONE Friday Fights with search_events, then calls get_event and shows the detail card: date and time, venue with map link, seating zones with prices, refund policy and a Buy tickets button.

positive.description: Event on a given evening and how to get there
positive.prompt: Is there a fight night at Lumpinee on Saturday evening, and how do I get there?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Saturday's event, shows its details with the venue map link, and answers how to reach the stadium.

positive.prompt: ลุมพินีมีมวยวันไหนบ้างเดือนนี้
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_events with locale th and answers in Thai. The list card is in Thai and booking links go to the Thai pages (/th/...).

negative.description: Asks the plugin to book and pay in chat. Expected: explains that booking and payment happen on lumpinee.ticket-official.com and gives the link; nothing is booked or charged.
negative.prompt: Book 2 ringside tickets for the next Lumpinee fight and pay with my card

negative.description: Asks for events at a different stadium. Expected: the plugin returns no events and makes nothing up, because it only covers Lumpinee Boxing Stadium.
negative.prompt: Find Muay Thai events at Rajadamnern Stadium

negative.description: Asks for a non-Muay Thai event at another venue. Expected: the plugin returns no events; it only covers Muay Thai at Lumpinee Boxing Stadium.
negative.prompt: Find me a football match at Rajamangala Stadium

review.commerce_description: The plugin is read-only and takes no payment. Each event links to lumpinee.ticket-official.com, where users choose seats and pay for admission to a live, in-person event. There is no cart or checkout in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First release: search Lumpinee Stadium events and view event details with a booking link.
